plan.notes: Recommended Course Sequence published in the 2023-2024 catalog (pp. 99-100). Lower bound used for ENGL 1A/1AS (4 or 5) -> ENGL 1A 4 units. Sequenced lower bounds sum to 60, matching the catalog's 60-unit degree total. The sequence substitutes MATH 15 for the MATH 225 listed in the degree major requirements, with catalog footnote 'Students can choose to take any other degree applicable math course' — kept verbatim as Major per the REQUIREMENT column. AUTOB 16 carries the catalog hard prerequisite 'AUTOB 10 or AUTOB 30'; AUTOB 30 precedes it in this plan, so prereq is coded as AUTOB 30. Category mapping: 'GE' -> core, 'Major' -> major, 'Elective' -> elective. Footnote 2: 'Student can complete a Small Business Administration Certificate if they complete BUS 54, 10, and 208.' Revalidated 2026-10-01 against the official College of Alameda 2024-2025 catalog (CoA-Catalog-24-25_PRINT_v1.pdf, 7,590,937 bytes, 416 pages; live alameda.edu copy 404s, retrieved via Wayback Machine capture 20250808180750): recommended course sequence verified identical to the 2023-2024 transcription. The 2025-2026 catalog is published only on Curriqunet (JS-rendered, no downloadable PDF); revalidation against it is pending a live-browser pass.
